backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile storage, membership minting/querying, and trial/active status checks, all gated by role-based access control via MixinAuthorization and AccessControl helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (Steiner philosophy copy, 'The Sevenfold Arts' terminology, and the arts grid) to their corresponding source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the Autumn/Spring design system, Steiner philosophy content, and component responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar) used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'Actuality Studio' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with landing and dashboard routes, renders the shared navigation/footer layout, orchestrates the profile setup modal, and includes the Toaster notification provider.
frontend/src/components/HeroBanner.tsx: Full-width hero banner component displaying the Actuality Studio branding with a warm cream gradient overlay, seasonal leaf/vine motif, and subtitle copy referencing Steiner's philosophy of architecture as supreme synthesis.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that toggles between a terracotta gradient sign-in state and an outline sign-out state, handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading feedback.
frontend/src/components/MembershipCard.t: Displays a user's NFT studio membership details (token ID, status, dates, trial info) in a styled card with active/trial/expired status badges.
frontend/src/components/MintMembershipBu: A button component that triggers the mint membership mutation, showing a loading spinner during minting and an error message on failure.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with logo, nav links (Home/Dashboard), auth controls, and a responsive mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Shows the authenticated user's truncated Internet Identity principal with a click-to-copy button and tooltip revealing the full principal.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog shown on first sign-in that prompts the user to enter their name and saves it as their profile via the saveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/SevenfoldArtsGri: Renders a themed grid section showcasing the seven Steiner arts disciplines, each with a name, description, and color-coded accent styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profile and membership data (including trial status, expiry, mint, and cancel) via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind, defining a warm autumn/spring CSS custom property palette with light and dark mode variants.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component displaying a hero banner, philosophical introduction to the Sevenfold Arts, a features grid, and a CTA section with conditional login/dashboard links based on authentication state.
frontend/src/pages/MembershipDashboard.t: Membership dashboard page that shows a login prompt for unauthenticated users or displays the user's NFT membership card and mint button, with loading skeletons while data is fetching.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, an OKLCH-based color palette (including autumn/spring semantic tokens like terracotta, sage-green, warm-gold), and plugin setup for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest for Actuality Studio, documenting the platform's Steiner-inspired Seven Arts philosophy, existing implemented features, architectural notes, and known issues at schema version 1.0.0.
